agentBehaviourHint: These settings apply to the current session and are reflected immediately in the chat pills.
approvalAutoHint: skips every prompt and lets the agent work uninterrupted.
approvalHint: Controls when the agent pauses for your confirmation before running a tool.
modeHint: Normal gives the agent full tool access. Plan restricts it to read-only exploration so it can analyse without changing anything.
thinkingHint: How much chain-of-thought reasoning the model performs before replying. Higher levels improve quality on complex tasks at the cost of latency and token usage.
